question: Writers seem like the type of people who develop problems with their neck, shoulders, and lower back. Could you tell us about any measures or stretches you use to reduce stiffness or pain?
answer:
My body is optimized for being a writer, so nothing hurts.

I sit and work all the time, but my lower back doesn't hurt, and while everyone seems to develop tendonitis, I don't get tendonitis either. My neck doesn't really hurt either.

A little while ago, a writer friend told me, “You've probably gone full circle and just don't notice anything anymore, so let's have you go to an osteopathic clinic at least once.”

So I went to the recommended clinic, and the practitioner was so amazed at how little was wrong with me that they said, “I'm sorry for charging you money when there's practically nothing wrong with you.” (laughs)
